_comment: THROWAWAY GUARD (COL-59). Golden sqlite_master snapshot captured from a real current-release Collapsarr database built by the pre-COL-56 create_all path (Base.metadata.create_all over the shipped models). It is an INDEPENDENT, FROZEN artifact -- not regenerated from the migration chain -- so it stays honest even if models/migrations later drift: it pins what unversioned installs in the wild actually have on disk. The fidelity test asserts `upgrade head` on an empty DB reproduces this schema (modulo constraint/whitespace ordering). Retire this fixture and its test once no unversioned (create_all-era) databases remain in the wild -- there is nothing left to adopt at that point.

objects.name: ix_job_history_job_id
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_job_history_job_id ON job_history (job_id)

objects.name: ix_tracked_media_files_file_path
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_tracked_media_files_file_path ON tracked_media_files (file_path)

objects.name: arr_instances
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE arr_instances (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	base_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	api_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	status_error TEXT, 
	status_checked_at DATETIME, 
	version VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_arr_instances_name UNIQUE (name)
)

objects.name: global_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE global_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	api_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	enabled_targets VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	language_allow_list VARCHAR(500), 
	stereo_codec VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	stereo_bitrate_kbps INTEGER, 
	surround_codec VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	surround_bitrate_kbps INTEGER, 
	concurrency_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ui_auth_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	auth_username VARCHAR(150), 
	auth_password_hash VARCHAR(255), 
	auth_method VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'forms' NOT NULL, 
	auth_required VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'local_bypass' NOT NULL, 
	session_secret VARCHAR(128), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_global_settings_singleton CHECK (id = 1)
)

objects.name: job_history
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_history (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_path VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	exit_code INTEGER, 
	error_text TEXT, 
	target VARCHAR(100), 
	language VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

objects.name: notifier_config
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE notifier_config (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	webhook_url VARCHAR(2048), 
	webhook_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	discord_webhook_url VARCHAR(2048), 
	discord_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_notifier_config_singleton CHECK (id = 1)
)

objects.name: remote_path_mappings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE remote_path_mappings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	remote_prefix VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	local_prefix VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	"order" INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(instance_id) REFERENCES arr_instances (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

objects.name: tracked_media_files
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE tracked_media_files (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	file_path VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

objects.name: tracked_media_target_status
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE tracked_media_target_status (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	target VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(27) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_tracked_media_target_status_media_language_target UNIQUE (media_id, language, target), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_id) REFERENCES tracked_media_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
